d: In this video, Firstpost takes a look at Donald Trump's unusual final campaign pitch ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections. Addressing a crowd of around 60 people near the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, the US President spoke about pipes, caulking, granite and algae instead of making a final appeal to voters. He even floated the idea of renaming the landmark the 'Trump Reflecting Pool'. With just hours to go before polling, Trump's speech left a rather unusual impression. Was this really the message voters needed to hear before Election Day? Hem Kaur Saroya brings you the details on…
